visa189ContextBand.title: Understanding Competition in ICT & Marketing
visa189ContextBand.text1: The 189 visa is one of the most competitive PR pathways in Australia. At present,
visa189ContextBand.highlight: ICT and Marketing applicants often require 95–100+ points
visa189ContextBand.text2: to receive an invitation. This does not mean the pathway is closed — it means every point matters, and strategy determines outcomes.
